name: treasury
description: Agent Treasury by Tempora Labs — treasury management plugin for AI agents; the agent's own wallet is the account. The earn skill puts idle USDC to work in measured ERC-4626 vaults on Base and Arbitrum One: lists vaults with measured deposit status, pre-flights a deposit by simulation, and builds UNSIGNED approve/deposit/withdraw calls for your own signer. Holds no keys; cannot sign or send.
